requirements.name: Wildspark repeater
requirements.brief: Wildspark class-default repeater with engine-controlled rotor animation. The repeater and the launcher are contributed together as one Wildspark set GLB under the Studio requirement wildspark.handheld.set: WildsparkSetRepeater and WildsparkSetLauncher nodes, launcher at scale 0 in the file. The game shows the variant for the current weapon mode and moves only its mechanism from the rest pose: WildsparkRotor in repeater mode. Authoring guide: docs/wildspark-skin-sets.md in github.com/o-moba/omoba-bevy. Custom moving-part animation requires a future profile. A reviewed set replaces both modes. A compatible single-gun skin applies to its own mode. A set that is not installed yet shows the class-default pair.

requirements.name: Wildspark launcher
requirements.brief: The second gun in the class-default Q switch, shown in rockets mode and while W or R draws it. The launcher and the repeater are contributed together as one Wildspark set GLB under the Studio requirement wildspark.handheld.set; this gun is its WildsparkSetLauncher variant, and its WildsparkSlide recoils from the rest pose. Authoring guide: docs/wildspark-skin-sets.md in github.com/o-moba/omoba-bevy. A standalone launcher skin requires a separate Wildspark approval and applies only in launcher mode. This is not a third Q weapon.
